svg.title: Moth speech-to-text architecture
svg.desc: Moth turns 16 kHz mono audio into an 80-bin log-mel, runs it through a Whisper-tiny encoder with two extra transformer blocks, projects every frame to 1,025 CTC tokens with a linear head, and decodes lowercase text with prefix beam search and a trigram language model. A Silero VAD gates silence and steady noise before the encoder.
